issues: Handset screen broken on desktop: .screen used font-size:3.5cqw on the size container itself, so it resolved against the viewport. Every screen element rendered about 3x too large: the Dynamic Island turned into a black bar across the top, the clock showed as a cropped giant '13', and the catalog Spotlight screen clipped to 'Protection ca'. The signature 'live phone' read as a glitch.
Product photos cropped with object-fit:cover. The kart chassis, tyre set and sprocket lost their edges, and on square 2x2 widgets the glass label covered the bottom third of the product.
Catalog Spotlight showed duplicate sections ('Protection cases' twice) because rows were grouped only when consecutive and products weren't ordered by category.
Hero home-screen widgets (photo plus tagline) were hidden behind an opacity entrance animation and missing from the captures, which left a dead gap under the CTAs on desktop.
Mobile nav row cut off hard at the edge ('Cont') with no hint that it scrolls.
Typography is strong (Sora/Manrope/JetBrains Mono) and the section metaphors (Control Center, App Library, widgets) land well. Brand robustness holds for both purple and red.
fixed: Screen type is now sized from the handset width (calc(var(--pw) * .032)) in both pages. The status bar, island pill, home-screen clock, wallpaper headline, Control Center, widgets and Spotlight screen now render at true phone scale.

Product images use object-fit:contain on a soft white studio backdrop with multiply blending, in widgets, on handset widget/product screens and in catalog thumbnails. Square widgets reserve bottom padding so the glass label no longer covers the product.
Catalog rows are stable-sorted by first appearance of their category before grouping, giving one Spotlight section per category.
Hero widgets get a transform-only spring entrance, so they never go invisible and the hero fills properly.
Mobile nav gets a fade mask on the right edge to signal it scrolls horizontally.
